opening.argument: The presentation promotes a paid OneCoin package by identifying a ProTrader package priced at $1,000 and explaining that its tokens are mined into coins. It applies purchase urgency by asserting that delaying a purchase reduces the coins received, while forecasting that the coin could reach 50 to 100 euros within two to three years. It also offers token rewards for inviting another person into the community. Together, these features connect payment to token acquisition, conversion into coins, projected appreciation, and referral-based rewards. The records do not establish completed transactions, realized returns, or the accuracy of those projections, and the ASR may contain transcription errors.
